title: Approving a CLI login without typing its code
items: whk auth login opens a page that already holds the code: check that it matches your terminal, and approve
The page says which client asked, from which country, and warns when the login came from another network than your browser
This wasn't me ends a login you did not start, at once
On a server over SSH, whk auth login prints the link to open in your own browser (--remote, detected by itself)
